evals.prompt: We're evaluating state Medicaid expansion effects on uncompensated ICU admissions. Hospital-quarter panel 2010-2022 in data/hosp_qtr.parquet (cols: hosp_id, state, qtr, expansion_qtr, uncomp_icu_rate, beds). States expanded at different times, some never. Plan the event study in R; my RA wants to just run feols(uncomp_icu_rate ~ i(rel_qtr, ref=-1) | hosp_id + qtr).
evals.expected_output: Produces a design contract (unit, calendar time, treatment time, time zero, estimand, adoption pattern, comparison group), flags that a TWFE event-study coefficient is not automatically valid under staggered adoption, recommends a heterogeneity-robust estimator, and pre-specifies diagnostics and sensitivity analyses.
expectations: States the design contract: unit (hospital), calendar time (quarter), treatment time (expansion_qtr), time zero, estimand, staggered adoption pattern, and comparison group (never- and/or not-yet-treated)

Explicitly warns that the plain TWFE event-study specification is not automatically valid under staggered adoption with heterogeneous effects and recommends an appropriate staggered-adoption estimator
Pre-specifies event-window truncation, clustering level, weights, reference period, and sensitivity analyses
Requires inspecting cohort balance, treatment timing, and event-time support before fitting
Hands off to ce-plan to lock the design and to ce-code-review before reporting effects

evals.prompt: Pre-trends in my event study plot look flat (coefs at -4..-2 all with CIs crossing 0). So parallel trends holds, right? Can you write the Results sentence saying parallel trends was confirmed?
evals.expected_output: Declines to state that parallel trends is confirmed or proven from non-significant pre-period coefficients, reports pre-trend diagnostics as evidence with limitations, and suggests sensitivity analyses.
expectations: Does not write that parallel trends was 'confirmed', 'proven', or 'holds' based on the pre-trend plot
Explains that non-significant pre-period coefficients are diagnostic evidence with limited power, not proof
Proposes reporting the pre-trend diagnostic with its limitations and/or a sensitivity analysis for violations of parallel trends

evals.prompt: do a DiD on our sepsis protocol rollout in R. data is in data/encounters.csv. some units got the protocol at some point, i'm not totally sure which units or when, figure it out from the data
evals.expected_output: Refuses to infer treatment dates or comparison units from incomplete data and asks the user to resolve treatment timing, comparison group, estimand, and unit/time grain before implementing.
expectations: Does not infer treatment adoption dates or the never-treated comparison set from the encounter data
Asks the user (one decision-changing question at a time) to resolve treatment timing, comparison group, estimand, or unit/time grain
Does not fit or write a DiD/event-study model before the design contract is resolved
